fullDescription: A documentation-grade teal button system: 8 interactive states (default, hover, active, focus-ring, disabled, loading spinner, success check, icon-only) across solid, outline and ghost variants in three sizes, with an async click-to-confirmation flow, all in pill-shaped Inter buttons on a clean slate canvas.

structured.summary: A complete, state-aware button system on a light slate canvas with a teal accent. One sticky-nav landing page that documents the full button kit: an 8-state x 3-variant matrix (default, hover, active, focus-ring, disabled, loading spinner, success check, icon-only), an icon-button bank on a dark panel, a small/medium/large size ladder, and a horizontal idle-to-success async lifecycle. Pill-shaped buttons, Inter typeface, generous rounded panels with soft shadows.

style.description: Crisp, documentation-grade product style. Light slate background, near-black ink text, a single teal accent used for primary actions and rings. Fully rounded (pill) buttons, large 22px-radius white panels with hairline borders and soft layered shadows, a faint teal dot-grid background texture, and one dark contrast section for the icon-button bank.
style.prompt: Use a clean, modern SaaS documentation aesthetic. Background canvas is slate-50 (#f8fafc); body text near-black ink (#0f172a) with secondary text slate-600 (#475569) and tertiary slate-500 (#64748b). Single accent color teal: primary teal-700 (#0f766e), hover teal-600 (#0d9488), active teal-800 (#115e59), focus-ring teal-300 (#5eead4), with teal-50 (#f0fdfa) and teal-100 (#ccfbf1) as soft tints. Typeface Inter (weights 400-900), antialiased, tight tracking on headings (font-weight 800/900), uppercase letter-spaced kickers at 11px with 0.2em tracking in teal-700. All buttons are fully pill-shaped (border-radius 9999px), font-weight 600, with a 0.18s color/shadow transition and a 1px translateY press. Panels are white with 1px slate-200 (#e2e8f0) borders, 22px radius, and a soft layered shadow (0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04), 0 18px 40px -28px rgba(15,23,42,.18)). Add a faint teal dot/line grid background (rgba(15,118,110,.05), 26px cells) behind the hero and blurred teal radial glows. Include one dark section using ink-900 (#0f172a) panels with white/10 borders for contrast.

layout_and_structure.description: A single vertical landing page, max-width ~1152px (max-w-6xl), centered. Sticky translucent header, two-column hero with a floating live-preview card, a full-width state matrix panel, a dark icon-button bank, a three-column size ladder, a centered async-flow strip, a centered CTA panel, and a slim footer. Collapses to single column and stacked cells on mobile.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (h-16) with a translucent slate-50/85 backdrop-blur and a 1px bottom shadow. Left: a 32px teal-700 rounded-xl logo tile with a white radio-button icon, the wordmark 'Stateful' in extrabold, and a small teal pill badge 'Button System'. Center (desktop only): nav links States, Icon buttons, Sizes, Async flow in slate-600 with teal-700 hover. Right: a small ghost 'Docs' button and a small solid teal 'Copy prompt' button with a copy icon.

A two-column hero (1.15fr / 0.85fr) over a faint teal dot-grid with two blurred teal radial glows. Left: a teal kicker 'Prompt Library · Components', a giant extrabold headline 'Every button, / every state, / one system.' (last line in teal-700), a slate-600 lead paragraph, two large buttons (solid teal 'Generate this set' with sparkle icon, outline teal 'View tokens' with code icon), and a row of three teal check-circle feature chips (8 states, 3 sizes, WCAG focus rings). Right (desktop only): a floating white preview card showing live button rows (Send + loading spinner, Save + success Sent, a row of icon buttons including a focus-ringed add and a disabled lock) with a 'Live preview / interactive' header and a footer showing a code token '--ring: #5eead4' and 'v2.1'.

A full-width white panel titled 'Eight states, three variants' with a teal 'The matrix' kicker and a legend (Solid / Outline / Ghost dots). Inside, a CSS grid with a 120px label column plus 8 state columns (Default, Hover, Active, Focus, Disabled, Loading, Success, Icon). Three rows: Solid (Send), Outline (Save), Ghost (Edit), each showing that variant rendered in all 8 states, cells separated by hairline dividers. On mobile it reflows to a 2/4-column card grid with per-cell state tags.

A dark full-bleed section (ink-900 #0f172a) with a faint white grid texture and a blurred teal glow. Centered heading 'Square, circular, and stateful' with a teal-300 kicker. Below, a 4-card grid (ink-800/60 panels, white/10 borders, backdrop blur), each labeled Default, Hover/Focus, Loading, and Success/Disabled, holding rows of icon-only pill buttons (play, heart, share, etc.) demonstrating that state.

A three-column section 'Small, medium, large' on white panels showing the same button set at 36px / 44px / 56px heights, each panel headed with the size name and a teal code chip ('36px', '44px', '56px'); the medium panel is highlighted with a teal-200 ring and a '· base' tag. Each panel stacks a labeled+icon button row, a loading+success row, and a row of four icon-only buttons (solid, outline, ghost, disabled).

A teal-tinted band (teal-50/60, teal-100 top/bottom borders) titled 'From click to confirmation'. A centered horizontal flow of four fixed-width (w-40) large buttons connected by teal arrow icons, captioned 1 · Idle, 2 · Pressed, 3 · Loading (spinner), 4 · Success (check). Stacks vertically with rotated arrows on mobile.

A centered white panel with a blurred teal glow, a teal 'Ready to build' kicker, an extrabold headline 'Ship the whole button system in one prompt.', a slate-600 supporting line, and two buttons centered: a solid teal 'Copy the prompt' (copy icon) and a ghost 'Browse the library' with a trailing up-right arrow icon.

A slim footer with a 1px slate-200 top border on slate-50: left the small teal logo tile + 'Stateful · Button System', right a slate-500 line 'A prompt-library component set · built for design agents'.

special_ui_components.prompt: Pill button base (.btn): inline-flex, gap 0.5rem, font-weight 600, border-radius 9999px, 1.5px transparent border, transitions on color/shadow/transform, translateY(1px) on :active.

Three variants: Solid (bg teal-700 #0f766e -> hover teal-600 #0d9488 -> active teal-800 #115e59, white text), Outline (white bg, teal-700 text, teal-200 #99f6e4 border -> hover teal-600 border + teal-50 bg), Ghost (transparent -> slate-100 #f1f5f9 hover bg).
WCAG focus ring: double box-shadow 0 0 0 3px #f8fafc, 0 0 0 5px #5eead4 (teal-300) applied on :focus-visible across all variants.
Disabled state: slate-100 bg, slate-400 text, slate-200 border, no shadow, cursor not-allowed, transform removed.
Loading spinner: 1.1em circle, 2.25px currentColor border with transparent top/right, spin 0.7s linear infinite.
Success state: solid teal with a teal-300 check icon, plus per-variant success treatments (outline shows teal check + tinted bg, ghost shows teal text + check).
Three sizes: sm 36px / md 44px / lg 56px (text 13/14/16px), with square icon-only variants at the same heights.
Code token chip (code.tok): ui-monospace on a teal-950 #042f2e background with teal-300 text, e.g. --ring: #5eead4.
Floating live-preview card and dark icon-bank cards with backdrop blur.
Iconify Phosphor icons (ph:*) and a faint teal dot-grid background texture.

structured.special_notes: Single teal accent only; do not introduce other hues. Buttons must be fully pill-shaped (radius 9999px) and use Inter. Every variant must render all eight states, and the focus ring must be the exact double-shadow #f8fafc + #5eead4. Keep one dark (ink-900) section for the icon-button bank for contrast; everything else is light slate. Loading uses an animated spinner, success uses a check icon, disabled uses muted slate. No em-dashes in copy.
